name: Selegiline
metabolism: Extensive presystemic metabolism forms N-desmethylselegiline, L-methamphetamine and L-amphetamine. These products have their own activity; their contribution to the clinical effect is not fully established.
summary: Selegiline, also known as L-deprenyl, is a monoamine oxidase inhibitor used to treat Parkinson's disease and major depressive disorder. It is the purified levorotatory enantiomer of racemic deprenyl.
